conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Can't see; attacks against have Advantage, own attacks have Disadvantage.
effects: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.summary: Can't harm charmer; charmer has Advantage on social checks.
effects: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact socially with you.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.summary: Can't hear; fail hearing checks; Disadvantage on Initiative.
effects: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.
You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.summary: Levels 1–6. -2 per level to D20 Tests, -5 ft Speed per level. Level 6 = Death.
effects: Exhaustion is measured in six levels.
Level 1: -2 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 5 ft.
Level 2: -4 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 10 ft.
Level 3: -6 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 15 ft.
Level 4: -8 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 20 ft.
Level 5: -10 penalty to D20 Tests, Speed reduced by 25 ft.
Level 6: You die immediately.
Completing a Long Rest removes 1 level of Exhaustion (provided food and water are consumed).

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on checks/attacks while source is in sight; can't move closer.
effects: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight.
You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.summary: Speed 0; Disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the grappler.
effects: Your Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.
You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
The grappler can drag or carry you when moving, moving at half Speed unless you are two or more sizes smaller.
Escape: You can use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple escape DC.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.summary: No Actions/Reactions; Concentration broken; Disadvantage on Initiative; Surprised = Incapacitated.
effects: You can't take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Your Concentration and readied actions are immediately broken.
You have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.
Surprise (2024 Rule): If surprised when combat begins, you have the Incapacitated condition until your first turn ends.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: Concealed; attacks against have Disadvantage, own attacks have Advantage; no Opportunity Attacks.
effects: You are impossible to see without magical sight or special senses.
Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage.
Your attack rolls have Advantage.
Equipment worn or carried is also concealed while on your person.
Creatures cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.summary: Incapacitated; can't move/speak; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; melee hits are crits.
effects: You have the Incapacitated condition.
You can't move or speak.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.summary: Turned to stone; Incapacitated; resist all damage; immune to poison/disease.
effects: You are transformed into an inanimate solid substance (usually stone).
Your weight increases tenfold and you cease aging.
You have the Incapacitated condition and can't move or speak.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
You have Resistance to all damage and are Immune to poison and disease.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
effects: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Crawl only (stand costs half movement); disadv on attacks; melee hits have adv, ranged disadv.
effects: Your only movement option is crawling, unless you stand up (costs half your Speed).
You have Disadvantage on attack rolls.
An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you; otherwise, the attack roll has Disadvantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Speed 0; attacks against have Adv, own attacks have Disadv; Disadv on Dex saves.
effects: Your Speed becomes 0 and can't increase.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Incapacitated; can't move; speak only falteringly; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; attacks against have Adv.
effects: You have the Incapacitated condition.
You can't move and can speak only falteringly.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: Incapacitated and Prone; drop items; unaware; auto-fail Str/Dex saves; melee hits are crits.
effects: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions.
You drop whatever you are holding.
You are unaware of your surroundings.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

conditions.name: Bloodied
conditions.summary: 50% Max HP or lower. Triggers various monster traits, feats, and spell effects.
effects: A creature is Bloodied when its current Hit Points are at or below half of its Hit Point maximum.
Used as a trigger for monster abilities, special tactical reactions, and player abilities.

actions_in_combat.name: Attack
actions_in_combat.description: Make one or more melee or ranged attacks with weapons or unarmed strikes (dependent on Extra Attack features). Includes Grappling and Shoving in 2024 as part of the Attack action.

actions_in_combat.name: Cast a Spell
actions_in_combat.description: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 Action (or Bonus Action / Reaction). Note 2024 Spell Slot rule: On your turn, you can expend only one spell slot to cast a spell.

actions_in_combat.name: Dash
actions_in_combat.description: Gain extra movement equal to your Speed (after applying any active modifiers) for the current turn.

actions_in_combat.name: Disengage
actions_in_combat.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.

actions_in_combat.name: Dodge
actions_in_combat.description: Until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage. You lose this benefit if Incapacitated or Speed drops to 0.

actions_in_combat.name: Help
actions_in_combat.description: Give an ally Advantage on their next ability check before the start of your next turn, or give Advantage on the next attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of you.

actions_in_combat.name: Hide
actions_in_combat.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check (DC 15). On success, you gain the Invisible condition until you make noise louder than a whisper, make an attack roll, or cast a spell with verbal components.

actions_in_combat.name: Influence
actions_in_combat.description: Make a Charisma check (Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation) to shift a creature's attitude (Hostile -> Indifferent -> Friendly) or compel them to take a specific course of action.

actions_in_combat.name: Ready
actions_in_combat.description: Wait for a perceivable circumstance before acting. Choose the trigger and the action you will take in response as a Reaction.

actions_in_combat.name: Search
actions_in_combat.description: Devote attention to finding something. Make a Wisdom check (Perception, Insight, or Survival) to locate hidden creatures, objects, tracks, or motives.

actions_in_combat.name: Study
actions_in_combat.description: Study a creature, object, or puzzle. Make an Intelligence check (Arcana, History, Nature, Religion, or Investigation) to recall lore, uncover monster weaknesses, or decipher clues.

actions_in_combat.name: Utilize
actions_in_combat.description: Interact with an object or feature that requires your action (drinking a potion, pulling a heavy lever, deploying a hunting trap, opening a locked door).

cover.effect: +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws (low wall, fallen tree, another creature).
+5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws (portcullis, arrow slit, thick oak trunk).
Cannot be targeted directly by attacks or spells (unless the spell specifies it spreads around corners).

resting.effect: Spend Hit Dice to regain HP (roll die + Con modifier per die). Recharges short-rest class features.
At least 6 hours sleeping, up to 2 hours light activity. Regain all lost HP, half total Hit Dice (minimum 1), reduce Exhaustion by 1 level. Interrupted if 1 hour of combat/casting occurs.

concentration.dc: DC 10 or half damage taken (whichever is higher). Must make Constitution saving throw.
Immediately loses concentration if Incapacitated or killed.
Concentration on the earlier spell ends immediately.

death_saves.result: Regain 1 Hit Point immediately and wake up conscious!
Suffers 1 Failure (or 2 Failures if from a Critical Hit within 5 ft).

rules_cheat_sheet.fall_damage: 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet fallen (maximum 20d6). Lands Prone unless creature avoids taking all damage.
